info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to laugh,to smile,to joke, to ridicule

examples: 'avasarAdyanapekzo hAso'pahAso Bavati. tvayA yadapahAsyaM me SrutvA' (rA॰2.27.2).
'avahAsaM tato muktvA rAvaRo vAkyamabravIt' (rA0 7.18.8). avahAsaH saninda upahAsaH.
'kaTaM nu sarvalokasya nAvahAsyA Bavemahi' (BA0 droRa0 75.3). avahAsyAH=upahAsayogyAH. antarlInamavahasya. ihAvahAsaH smitaparyAyaH. sArTako'vaSabdaH.
'kimiti vizIdati roditi vikalA vihasati yuvatisaBA tava sakalA' (gIta0 9). vihasati upahasati. virudDo hAso vihAsaH.
'kiM cid vihasyArTapatiM baBAze' (raGu0 2.46). vihasya smitaM kftvA. iha viSabda IzadarTe.
'parasya lAGavamApAdayituM yo hAsaH sa upahAsaH. amaragurumapi prajYayopahasadBiH' (kAda0). atiSayAnErityupacarito'rTaH.
